title: Vision Navigation
description: Per-drone configuration for the ADOS Vision Navigation plugin.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Operating mode. optical_flow uses a downward camera plus a rangefinder; optical_flow_degraded takes its scale from the barometer (or GPS height in outdoor mode) instead; external_nav sends the pose from a shared pose topic (for example a lidar SLAM) as ODOMETRY and switches the EKF source set; off keeps the plugin loaded but silent.

active.title: Engaged
active.description: Written by the Engage Skill. Off idles vision navigation: nothing is sent to the flight controller.

flow_quality_min.title: Flow quality gate
flow_quality_min.description: Minimum optical-flow quality (0-255) for the estimator to report converged and for the pre-arm flow check to pass.

outdoor.title: Outdoor mode
outdoor.description: Outdoor mode: allow the GPS altitude rung, measured from the first 3D fix.

external_nav.title: External navigation
external_nav.description: Used in external_nav mode. The pose topic must be published by an installed plugin; the agent refuses the mode without it.

pose_topic.title: Pose topic
pose_topic.description: Shared topic carrying the pose descriptor (map frame converted to FRD).

origin_lla.title: EKF origin
origin_lla.description: [latitude deg, longitude deg, altitude m AMSL] of the take-off site. Sent as SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN when the flight controller has none, is disarmed, and GPS is not primary, 5 s after the flight controller boots. Prefer the flight controller setting it at boot (AHRS_OPTIONS bit 4 with AHRS_ORIGIN_LAT/LON/ALT set to the same place). Required in external_nav mode unless GPS is primary.

extnav_set.title: External-nav source set
extnav_set.description: EKF source set (EK3_SRCn) whose position and yaw source is ExternalNav.

fallback_set.title: Fallback source set
fallback_set.description: EKF source set used when the external pose is lost (the flight controller's optical-flow set), or the GPS set when GPS is primary.

gps_primary.title: GPS primary
gps_primary.description: Fly on GPS and switch to the external pose only while the GPS has no 3D fix or reports a horizontal accuracy worse than 5 m.

obstacle.title: Obstacle feed
obstacle.description: Turns a shared planar scan into OBSTACLE_DISTANCE for the flight controller's proximity avoidance (PRX1_TYPE 2).

sectors.title: Sectors
sectors.description: Number of equal sectors over 360 degrees (72 = 5 degrees each).

rangefinder.title: Rangefinder
rangefinder.description: Distance source used to scale optical flow into metric velocity.

topology.title: Topology
topology.description: Where the rangefinder is wired. companion = plugin reads it; fc = flight controller already publishes DISTANCE_SENSOR; none = no rangefinder.

driver.title: Driver
driver.description: fc_relay reads the flight controller's DISTANCE_SENSOR stream; tfluna_uart reads a Benewake TF-Luna on a companion serial port.

device.title: Device node
device.description: Serial device path (for example /dev/ttyUSB0) for the TF-Luna. Optional when topology is fc or none.

baud.title: Baud rate
baud.description: Only used for the TF-Luna UART driver.

type.title: Firmware
type.description: Flight controller firmware. ArduPilot and iNav (7.0+) receive OPTICAL_FLOW; PX4 receives OPTICAL_FLOW_RAD. Betaflight is not supported because the firmware has no position estimator.

camera_id.title: Flow camera id
camera_id.description: Agent camera id the flow is computed from, for example the downward camera. Empty takes frames from every camera.

device_path.title: Device path
device_path.description: Reported to the GCS as the camera when no flow camera id is set. Frames come from the agent's vision bus; choose the captured camera in the agent's camera settings.

orientation.title: Mount orientation
orientation.description: Both optical-flow modes need downward (or auto); forward or side leaves vision navigation disengaged.
